decisions.recommended_policy_en: Positive-length interval remainder: ordered closures of positive-length connected remnants after removing positive-length overlap; point minuend empty; point subtrahend/touch does not remove length; not strict set difference.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 正长度区间残余：扣除正长度重叠，返回有序的正长度残余连通分量闭包；点被减项为空，减点或端点相接不移除长度；不是严格集合差。

decisions.recommended_policy_en: After geometry/shape/finite/nonnegative validation: at z>=90, all-zero sources yield HorizonZero at 90 and NightZero above 90. Any nonzero source defaults to UnsupportedNoDirectDiffuse. Explicit ZeroAtOrBelowHorizon opt-in may discard those sources. For z<90 all-zero yields ZeroIrradiance; DNI=DHI=0 with GHI>0 yields ContradictoryIrradiance. No diffuse-only topology; future model revision only.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 先做几何/shape/有限性/非负校验：z>=90且全部源为零，z=90返回HorizonZero，z>90返回NightZero；任何非零源默认UnsupportedNoDirectDiffuse。只有显式ZeroAtOrBelowHorizon才丢弃源并返回具名零状态。z<90全零返回ZeroIrradiance；DNI=DHI=0且GHI>0返回ContradictoryIrradiance。DiffuseOnlyNoDirect留给未来model revision。
decisions.boundary: Policy checkpoint only; not the complete requested launch-approval package and not Owner approval.

decisions.recommended_policy_en: Single signed clamped mu; front above +delta, back below -delta, inclusive grazing band otherwise. delta=64*f64::EPSILON=1.4210854715202004e-14; reversal uses -mu, never recomputes recursively. Bound is conditional on normalized degree domain, ordinary FP and <=2 ulp trig; 16 CI configurations tested. Grazing suppresses direct/circumsolar projections, not isotropic/horizon.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 单次计算并裁剪mu，mu>delta为front，mu<-delta为back，其余为grazing；delta=64*f64::EPSILON=1.4210854715202004e-14。法向反转使用-mu，不递归重算。误差界依赖归一角域、普通浮点运算及trig<=2ulp假设；16个CI配置已实测。grazing仅使direct/circumsolar投影归零，保留isotropic/horizon。
decisions.boundary: Policy checkpoint only; not the complete requested launch-approval package and not Owner approval.

decisions.recommended_policy_en: Incident form qinc=E+FRqinc, B=I-FR, q0=Rqinc; move known sky into b. No explicit inverse. Finite rho/albedo in [0,1], zero legal. Separate F/G; Gground=(1-albedo)Fground. Residual uses original B,b; high condition needs independent forward evidence or NumericalFailure. Backend/version/layout deferred. New LCB-01 geometric F defect is NOT silently covered by these absorption/solver decisions.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 采用incident形式qinc=E+FRqinc、B=I-FR、q0=Rqinc；已知sky移到b。不显式inverse；有限rho/albedo∈[0,1]且0合法。F/G分离，Gground=(1-albedo)Fground。原B,b算residual，高条件数需独立前向证据或NumericalFailure。backend/version/layout后定。LCB-01的几何F缺陷不能静默归入现有吸收/solver修正。

decisions.recommended_policy_en: Tentative HybridPerezTwoSidedExplicitBand-v1: receiver-side horizontal normal selects adjacent row; highest endpoint and receiving-surface centroid define max(0,atan2(dy,abs(dx))); h=min(1,theta/band), H=abs(P_horizon)*(1-h). Require explicit finite band in (0,90]; no asserted 6.5-degree physical default. Geometry/mirror probes passed, but raw Reference/front correction comparison and complete source oracles remain unfinished at the LCB-01 stop.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 暂拟HybridPerezTwoSidedExplicitBand-v1：按接收面水平法向选邻排，最高端点与接收面质心定义max(0,atan2(dy,abs(dx)))；h=min(1,theta/band)，H=abs(P_horizon)*(1-h)。band须显式给定且有限、在(0,90]；不宣称6.5度默认值有物理标定依据。几何/mirror探针通过，Reference对照与完整源项oracle因LCB-01停点尚未完成。

decisions.recommended_policy_en: Fast Isotropic Pps=Piso-(1-tau)*Dfront; tau=0 gives Piso-Dfront, .5 gives Piso-.5Dfront, 1 gives Piso. Target correction rho_front*F_target,front_shaded*tau*Dfront vanishes for rho=0/no neighbor/no shaded view. Full/Fast remain distinct; full edge/segment reference fixtures are not yet built.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: Fast Isotropic采用Pps=Piso-(1-tau)*Dfront；tau=0/.5/1分别为Piso-Dfront、Piso-.5Dfront、Piso。目标修正rho_front*F_target,front_shaded*tau*Dfront在rho=0、无邻排、无可见阴影时为0。Full/Fast保持不同；完整edge/segment Reference fixtures尚未生成。

Public cancellation token is NOT a V1 frozen requirement; optional internal cancellation must not affect physics.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 保留Full q0/qinc/qabs、Fast q0/qabs unavailable、keyed ragged trace、标量广播/T=0/原始非单调顺序/dayofyear1..366。AOI成对配置、table覆盖0/180、knot严格递增、线性插值；SAPM B0..B5。不提供Python运行时callback；detach前复制owned输入，输出独立拥有内存。公共cancellation token不属于V1冻结要求，内部可选取消不改变物理模型。

Agent must not have admin/bypass/release rights. Use separate nonadmin identity, protected refs and explicit credential capability limits; ordinary contents-write alone cannot deny merge/tag. Otherwise sign time-bounded named governance risk acceptance. No rules applied here.

decisions.recommended_policy_en: Keep bounded resources and isolated benchmark protocol. Wide workload corpus is mandatory. If real crossover exists, learn/select it on holdout; if broad evidence shows no crossover, justified Serial fallback is valid. A missing cost estimator returning Serial always is invalid. Regret median<=1.10*best+2ms,p95<=1.25*best+5ms are candidate budgets to freeze with evidence before M11/M12, not immutable physics.
decisions.recommended_policy_zh_CN: 保留有界资源和隔离benchmark协议。必须覆盖足够宽workload；实测存在crossover时需学习并在holdout正确选择，足够宽证据证明不存在时Serial fallback合法。未实现cost estimator而总选Serial不合法。median<=1.10*best+2ms、p95<=1.25*best+5ms为M11/M12前凭证据冻结的候选预算，不是不可修订物理语义。
